a: ပဋိသေဝတိ(ကြိ)

သေဝ သေဝနေ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၃၎၂။ ဤသေဝနတ္ထ-၌ 'သေဝတိ, သေဝနာ, သေဝကော'စသည်ဖြင့် သဒ္ဒနီတိ(နီတိ၊ဓာ၊နှာ-၁၇၁)ပြယုဂ်ထုတ်သည်ကား 'သိ သေဝါယံ...သုဂန္ဓံ သေဝတီတိ သိခဏ္ဍော။ စူဠာ' စသော ဓာတွတ္ထဝိဂြိုဟ် မောဂ္ဂလ္လာန်(ဏွာဒိ။ ၅၉)ဆိုသည်ကို ဓာတုဝိဂြိုဟ်ယောင်၍ ထုတ်ဟန် ရှိသည်။ လောကီကျမ်းတို့၌ ၎င်းပြယုဂ်တို့ကို 'သေဝ' ဓာတ်မှာသာ ထုတ်သည်။ ဓာတွတ္ထ၊ သျ။ ၃၉၉-ဂါထာ။ သေဝတိ၊ သေဝတေ၊ ကဝိကပ္ပဒ္ဒုမ၊ ဓာတုရူပ ကပ္ပဒ္ဒုမ။၁၅၂။] မှီဝဲ-သုံးဆောင်-ခံစား-၏။

DOP: paṭisevati patisevati ( so usually ( so often Ee and paṭiseveti ~ayati), pr. 3 sg. [ BHS pratisevati], 1. indulges in, practises; Vin I 96, 26 (yo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ ~ati assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo); III 21, 24 (yo pana bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ ~eyya pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso ti); A II 5, 15 (puggalo kāme ca ~ati pāpaṃ ca kammaṃ karoti); Ja IV 118, 17* (ye kāme ~anti nirayaṃ te upapajjare); VI 73, 21 (puttaṃ laddhuṃ vaṭṭati lokadhammaṃ ~athā ti); — 2. makes use of; D III 38, 4 (so bhagavā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni ~ati); M I 10, 5 foll. (bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ ~ati; Vism 30, 29 : ~atī ti paribhuñjati, nivāseti vā pārupati vā); Th 732 (gandhe ce ~ati); Ja III 61, 19 (gandhamālādīni na ~ati); Vism 46, 4* (yoniso paccavekkhitvā ~etha paccaye); Mp III 141, 6 (pānabhojanādīni ca ~ati); Saddh 396 (vātātapaparittānaṃ … cīvaraṃ ~aye); — 3. experiences, undergoes; S I 57, 16* (kammaṃ … yassa assumukho rodaṃ vipākaṃ ~ati) = Dhp 67 (Dhp-a II 40, 9 : ~atī ti anubhoti); Ja VI 235, 23* (pubbe tassa kataṃ pāpaṃ tam eso ~ati); — fut. 1 sg. ( a ) paṭisevissaṃ, Ja VI 505, 18* (aghaṃ taṃ ~issaṃ vane); ( b ) paṭisevissāmi, Vin III 37, 31 ; A V 202, 9 ; — part.pr. ( a ) paṭiseva(t), mfn. , Vin IV 134, 3 (~ato); M I 130, 7 ; Nidd I 131, 24 ; — neg. a(p)paṭiseva(t), mfn. , M I 10, 20 ; A III 389, 1 ; ( b ) paṭisevanta, mfn. , Vin III 189, 20 ; V 33, 11 (methunaṃ dhammaṃ ~anto kati āpattiyo āpajjati); Ja IV 117, 28* ; Vism 34, 21 (taṃ senāsanaṃ evaṃ jānitvā paccavekkhitvā ~anto); Peṭ 123, 15 (imāni dve bhesajjāni ~anto, Ce so; Be, Ee ~ento); — neg. a(p)paṭisevanta, mfn. , Ps I 77, 25 ; Mp III 396, 12 ; ( c ) paṭisevamāna, mfn. , M I 478, 11 ; Vism 40, 15 ; Nidd-a I 176, 7 (ahitaṃ parivajjento hitaṃ ca ~amāno); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) paṭisevi, Vin III 34, 10 ; Ja III 275, 28 ; ( b ) paṭisevittha, Ja VI 525, 26* ; 2 sg. ( a ) paṭisevi, Kkh 2 71, 3 ; ( b ) ( or 2 pl. ?) paṭisevittho, Ja IV 222, 9* (visaṃ mā ~ittho papātaṃ parivajjaya, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~ittha); 3 pl. paṭiseviṃsu, Vin III 34, 16 ; D III 88, 28 ; Pj II 254, 23 ; — absol. paṭisevitvā, Vin III 28, 14 ; Ja VI 470, 30´ ; Kkh 2 29, 16 ; — neg. a(p)paṭisevitvā, Sp 516, 1 ; — pass. part.pr. paṭiseviyamāna, mfn. , It-a II 8, 8 ; — pp paṭisevita , mfn., indulged in, practised; made use of; Vin III 19, 29 (purāṇadutiyikāya methuno dhammo ~o); M III 125, 8 ; — fpp paṭisevitabba , mfn. , Vin I 96, 25 (methuno dhammo na ~o); Ja VI 505, 26´ (yaṃ araññe vasantena ~aṃ dukkhaṃ); Vism 31, 9 (sītassa paṭighātāya cīvaraṃ ~an ti bhagavā anuññāsi).

DOP: paṭiseni, paṭisenī f. [paṭi + senī], or paṭiseni(n), m ( fn ). [ from paṭisenā or from paṭi + senī], an opposing association or group; Nidd I 397, 29 (na hi santo paṭisenikarontī ti … ~iṃ paṭimallaṃ paṭikaṇṭakaṃ paṭipakkhaṃ na karonti na janenti …; Nidd-a I 421, 16 : ~in ti paṭisattuṃ).

paṭisenikaroti pr. 3 sg. [paṭisenā or paṭiseni + karoti; cf S. śreṇikṛta], acts as an opposing army or opposing group; forms a line against, opposes; ( ?) Sn 932 (pharusena ne na paṭivajjā na hi santo ~onti; Nidd I 397, 29 foll.: paṭiseniṃ paṭimallaṃ paṭikaṇṭakaṃ paṭipakkhaṃ na karonti na janenti …); — see also paṭiseniyati, paṭisseneti.

paṭisenikatta(r), paṭisenikatta m. [ from paṭisenikaroti?], one who acts as an opposing army or group; an opponent; ( ?) Sn 832 (na hi te ’dha atthi vādamhi jāte ~ā; Pj II 542, 18 : ~ā ti paṭilomakārako; Nidd I 173, 28 : ~ā paṭilomakattā paṭikaṇṭakakattā paṭipakkhakattā kalahaṃ kareyya, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se kareyyuṃ).
